Pre-reads and notes:
- I attached our mutual-action-plan draft (mutual-action-plan.pdf). Please scan section 2 (network & keys) and section 5 (rollback / switchover) — we'll allocate time to walk those items in the call.
- CIDR requirements + minimal firewall egress we recommend: 3x /28 blocks for control plane + model sync (we'll send a formal list after your SRE confirms whether they're NATed behind a single egress).
- Short answers on rollback: typical rollback path is (a) promote previous model variant, (b) flush/restore KV caches from snapshot, (c) route traffic to previous pool — in our experience an automated rollback can be exercised in ~6–12 minutes depending on model size and KV warmup; we'll demo the sequence with estimates.

Meeting agenda (final):
